definitions.explanation: A refundable deposit paid when renting an apartment in Japan, typically 1-2 months' rent. Used to cover repairs for damages beyond normal wear and tear.

examples.japanese: {敷金|しききん}は{家賃|やちん}の2{ヶ月分|かげつぶん}です。
examples.english: The security deposit is two months' rent.

examples.japanese: {退去時|たいきょじ}に{敷金|しききん}の{一部|いちぶ}が{返|かえ}ってきた。
examples.english: Part of the security deposit was returned when I moved out.

examples.japanese: {敷金|しききん}{礼金|れいきん}なしの{物件|ぶっけん}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a property with no deposit or key money.

notes:
COMPOUND: {敷|し}く (to spread, lay) + {金|きん} (money)

JAPANESE RENTAL SYSTEM:
・{敷金|しききん} (security deposit) - refundable
・{礼金|れいきん} (key money) - non-refundable
・Both are typically paid upfront when signing a lease

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{敷金|しききん}を{払|はら}う (pay the security deposit)
・{敷金|しききん}が{戻|もど}る (security deposit is returned)
・{敷金|しききん}ゼロ (zero deposit)

NOTE: In recent years, more '0ゼロ{物件|ぶっけん}' (zero-zero properties) with no {敷金|しききん} or {礼金|れいきん} have become available.
